title: Level B2 Intensive French
description: Development of upper-intermediate language skills and intercultural competencies to achieve greater fluency and spontaneity, enabling effortless interactions with native speakers. Production of clear, detailed text and conversations on a wide range of concrete and abstract topics. Advances to a B2 level of the European Common Framework for Languages. Prepares for advanced (C1) study upon completion.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of FRAN 180, FRAN 181, FRAN 182, FREN 175, FREN 180, FREN 181, FREN 182, FREN 190, FREN 195.
Normal entry point for student with French Immersion to Grade 12.
